3. Oxidizing Nature As discussed earlier, SO2 also behaves as a good oxidizing agent. Let's see some reactions that depict the oxidizing nature of SO2. a. Action with H2S
Sulphur dioxide oxidizes hydrogen sulphide to sulphur. 2H2S + SO2 → 2H2O + 3S
b. Action with Fe Sulphur dioxide oxidizes iron to iron oxide and iron sulphide.
